description: Routing eval — given a user prompt, which Nimble capability does the skill's routing guidance select? Grades the routing instructions in SKILL.md, not a live Nimble run.

routes.EXTRACT: nimble extract — fetch one known URL
routes.TEMPLATE: Step 0 Extraction Template check for a named site + direct item
routes.SEARCH: nimble search — raw results to skim
routes.WSA: Web Search Agent — synthesized, cited deliverable
routes.MAP: nimble map — discover URLs on a site

cases.prompt: create report on best AI agents framework in 2026
cases.why: Regression case (Cowork, v1.0.0 routed this to SEARCH). Gate A finds no location signal; Gate B sees the deliverable nouns 'report' and 'best X'.

cases.prompt: find articles about AI agent frameworks
cases.why: Same topic as case 1, but the deliverable is raw material to skim — 'find articles about'. Cases 1 and 2 must not collapse onto the same route.

cases.prompt: compare pricing across the top 5 web observability vendors
cases.why: 'compare' is a Gate B synthesis verb; no single page holds the answer.
'latest news' is a Gate B raw-material trigger and maps to the news focus mode.

cases.prompt: build a list of Series B fintech companies in NYC with their headcount
cases.why: 'build a list' plus per-entity attributes — dataset_building, not a search.
Gate A resolves on a direct URL; Gate B is never reached.

cases.prompt: get me the product details for Amazon ASIN B08N5WRWNW
cases.why: Named site plus a direct item identifier — Step 0 template check runs first.

cases.prompt: find all the pages on example.com
cases.why: URL inventory request — Gate A resolves it.

cases.prompt: archive every post in the example.com blog section
cases.why: Bulk section fetch — Gate A resolves it.

cases.prompt: give me a brief on how gizmotech.io positions itself, their site has no template
cases.why: Two things at once. Routing: a named site with no Extraction Template falls through Gate A to Gate B, where 'brief' lands on a Web Search Agent rather than a raw extract. Fork: a single-site positioning brief is medium effort, below the high+ threshold, so the skill must NOT prompt — this is the guard against fork-offer creep on cheap runs.
